mediaWork.title: Unjust & Unsolved
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Weekly deep dives into cases of people claiming wrongful conviction while the underlying crimes remain unresolved.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: Investigative series hosted by Pulitzer Prize-winning journalist Maggie Freleng profiling potentially wrongfully convicted individuals (including Brandon Spencer, Cheri Hayden, Andre Brown, Ralph Trent Stokes, and others) and examining the unsolved crimes behind their convictions.
mediaWork.availabilityNotes: Apple Podcasts · Public RSS feed verified · ~3 episodes on Apple Podcasts
